speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your symptoms in more detail: do the leg pains feel like deep bone aches, and have you noticed any specific patterns to your fevers or bruising?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). The combination of a 4-year-old girl presenting with prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe night pain is highly suggestive of ALL. Immediate referral for a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and peripheral smear is required. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential and peripheral smear.
